[[File:Paris.png|thumb|250px|Paris]] '''Paris''' (Japanese: '''パリス''' ''Paris'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP086|Arriving in Style!]]''. She is a well-known [[Pokémon Stylist]] and a former student of [[Hermione]]. She often says the French phrase "{{tt|très bien|very good}}." Paris met with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in front of the [[Hearthome Gym]], and she recognized Ash as the winner of [[Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition]]. After telling Ash that [[Fantina]] hadn't returned from her training journey yet, she suggested {{an|Dawn}} should enter her {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}} and Ash his {{AP|Pikachu}} in the famous Pokémon fashion show, the [[Hearthome Collection]], of which she was one of the judges. During the competition, Paris was pleasantly surprised with the style exhibited by Ash's Pikachu and commented on the uniqueness of his performance, as his getup greatly differed from the outfits usually displayed in these events. She also spoke positively about Dawn's Buneary's dress and necklace, complimenting Dawn for using minimalism to highlight her Pokémon's charm. Prior to {{an|Enta}} announcing the results, when {{TRT}} threatened to steal the prizes intended to the Top 3 contestants, Paris used her {{p|Lopunny}} to damage their [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] and send them blasting off with the help of Dawn and her Buneary. According to Hermione, Paris's successful career has led many people to wanting to become a Pokémon Stylist. She reappeared in a fantasy and photograph in ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'', where she was seen on the cover of the {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Poké Chic}} magazine with her Lopunny, and in a [[Photography|photo]] with Dawn, Lopunny, and Hermione at [[Johanna]]'s house. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} This listing is of Paris's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Paris |pkmn=Lopunny |type1=Normal |img=Paris Lopunny.png |epnum=DP086 |epname=Arriving in Style! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen= |desc={{p|Lopunny}} is Paris's only known Pokémon. It was first seen outside of the [[Hearthome Gym]] coming out of a limousine with Paris, after {{Ash}} found out that [[Fantina]] was not back yet. Paris invited {{an|Dawn}} and Ash to participate in the [[Hearthome Collection]] with their {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} respectively, to which they both agreed on. Lopunny was seen again during the competition, when {{TRT}} came back to try to steal all the accessories. Lopunny easily damaged [[Team Rocket's mechas|Team Rocket's mecha]] with Hidden Power and then sent it flying away with a double Bounce with the help of Buneary. It reappeared in a photograph in ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'' at [[Johanna]]'s house on the cover of a magazine with Paris, and again in a picture on the wall along with [[Hermione]], Buneary, Paris, and Dawn.
